intro.h2: Tile, waterproofing and a quote that does not change
paragraphs: Big Build Construction is a Kent company handling bathroom remodeling in Kent, WA and across King and Pierce counties. Owner Oleg Nikityuk manages each job directly, so you have one person to call from consultation to punch list. Every project starts with a line-by-line scope and a fixed price in writing.

Western Washington is hard on bathrooms, so the work below the tile gets as much attention as the finish. Oleg's crew rebuilds waterproofing from the studs, swaps old supply lines for PEX while walls are open and fits humidity-sensing fans. Reviewers call the tile clean, even and level, with smooth cuts and tidy work areas.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Kent, WA and the rooms around it

items.name: Bathroom Remodels
items.blurb: From a new vanity and re-tiled surround to full gut remodels with rerouted plumbing, soaking tubs, frameless glass and heated floors. Most bathrooms take 3 to 6 weeks. The site lists typical costs from $10,000 for a cosmetic refresh to $50,000+ for a full primary suite.

image.alt: Remodeled Kent-area bathroom with herringbone tile tub surround, gray quartz double vanity, black framed mirrors and a small chandelier

items.name: Tub-to-Shower and Accessible Baths
items.blurb: Converting a tub to a shower is one of the most requested jobs, covering plumbing changes, waterproofing, tile and glass. For aging in place the team builds curbless showers, adds grab bars that blend in, sets comfort-height toilets and widens doorways.

image.alt: White subway tile walk-in shower with black hex tile floor, corner shelves and matte black fixtures beside a built-in tub

items.name: Kitchen Remodels
items.blurb: Quartz counters, soft-close cabinetry, lighting and open layouts, sequenced around cabinet lead times so the written schedule holds. Kitchens typically run $15,000 for cosmetic work to $75,000+ for a full custom remodel, with design plans you approve before demo.

image.alt: Kitchen remodel with charcoal shaker cabinets, brass pendant lights and faucet, white quartz counters and wood-look LVP flooring

items.name: Flooring, Trim and Whole-Home Updates
items.blurb: When the job is bigger than one room: LVP or hardwood throughout, drywall repair and finishing, trim and baseboard carpentry, custom tile in wet areas and updated fixtures. The crew has modernized ramblers in Kent and split-levels in Renton and Federal Way.

why_choose_us.h2: What South King County homeowners get from Big Build

items.title: A fixed price, in writing
items.text: Each quote is fixed-price, itemized and approved line by line before work begins. If old wiring or plumbing turns up after demo, it is flagged in writing right away, not added to a final invoice.

items.title: The owner does the work
items.text: Oleg manages every job and stays your single point of contact. Google reviewers name him directly for responsive communication and tile that is level, smooth and finished with perfect grout.

about.h2: Meet Oleg Nikityuk, owner and founder
about.text: Oleg Nikityuk founded Big Build Construction in Kent and brings more than 15 years of remodeling experience to it. He keeps the company small on purpose, keeping only a handful of jobs open at once so each client gets his full attention. Oleg runs a tight site: floors protected, dust controlled, debris hauled away daily and weekly progress updates. Clients describe him as responsive and detail-focused, and several reviews credit him personally for the tile. Big Build also partners with licensed, insured trade professionals across King and Pierce counties.

service_area.h2: Based in Kent, working across King and Pierce counties
service_area.text: Big Build is based in Kent, so South King County jobs get quick site visits, cabinet deliveries and same-morning inspection fixes. The crew works most often in Kent, Auburn, Renton, Tukwila and Federal Way, and also takes projects in Covington, Maple Valley, Newcastle, Bellevue, Seattle, Tacoma and Bonney Lake. If you are elsewhere in King or Pierce County, call to confirm.

items.q: What do Kent bathroom remodels usually run?
items.a: Big Build lists bathroom remodels from about $10,000 for a cosmetic refresh to $50,000+ for a full luxury primary bath. The biggest cost drivers are scope, tile, fixtures and whether plumbing moves. You get an itemized, fixed-price estimate after the free in-home consultation, before any work begins.

items.q: How many weeks should I plan around?
items.a: Plan on 3 to 6 weeks for a typical bathroom. Simple cosmetic updates can wrap up in 1 to 2 weeks, while gut remodels that move plumbing and add a custom shower can take 6 to 8 weeks. You get a start date, a completion date and weekly progress updates.

items.q: Can my old tub become a walk-in or curbless shower?
items.a: Yes, and it is among the jobs Big Build is asked for most. The crew handles the plumbing changes, waterproofing, tile and frameless glass door. If you need it, they can build a barrier-free curbless shower with grab bars and non-slip flooring for aging in place.

items.q: What if the crew uncovers rot or bad wiring?
items.a: Older homes often hide worn supply lines, old wiring or rot once things are opened up. Big Build flags every one of those issues in writing the moment it is found, with the cost, so you decide before anything changes. There are no surprise invoices at the end.

Call (206) 356-5380 or email info@bigbuildconstruction.net. The contact page lists hours of Monday to Friday 7:00 am to 9:00 pm and Saturday 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, closed Sunday. Online requests usually get a callback the same business day and an estimate within 24 hours.
